contests.title: 12th Judicial District Attorney Question 7A
contests.scopeNote: The entire 12th Judicial District: Alamosa, Conejos, Costilla, Mineral, Rio Grande, and Saguache counties. Exact official county union supplied as place-map data; no county substitutes for the district.

provenance.quote: Pursuant to the authority granted by C.R.S. §1-4-1404, shall the term limits for the District Attorney of the 12th Judicial District established in Article XVIII § 11(1) of the Colorado Constitution be eliminated, allowing the District Attorney of the 12th Judicial District to serve an indefinite number of terms?
provenance.sourceOrg: Rio Grande County Clerk and Recorder

measures.questionText: Pursuant to the authority granted by C.R.S. §1-4-1404, shall the term limits for the District Attorney of the 12th Judicial District established in Article XVIII § 11(1) of the Colorado Constitution be eliminated, allowing the District Attorney of the 12th Judicial District to serve an indefinite number of terms?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Remove the Colorado constitutional term limit for the 12th Judicial District’s district attorney, allowing the officeholder to serve an indefinite number of terms. This concerns the district attorney, not judges or other elected offices.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Eliminate this district attorney term limit and allow an indefinite number of terms.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not eliminate this district attorney term limit through this question.
